notes: Essential never printed voting-intention crosstabs by gender/age/state in its weekly reports — checked the full text of all three final-week PDFs: no VI demographic tables exist. Dims are none for 2013/2019 and only the printed already-voted split for 2016. That split (22% of enrolled respondents said they had already voted) reads {Have/Have not} voted with per-cell 2PP as printed (L–NP shown: Have-voted 54–46, Have-not 49–51; alp2 recorded).

2013 final wave column '5/9/13': Liberal National 43 / Labor 35 / Greens 10 / Other+Independent 12; 2PP 52–48 (2010 flows); don't-know excluded. The report's About page (sample, fieldwork dates, house panel) is not readable in the saved copies — the 2013-era subsetted fonts strip most of it in extraction — so sample and fieldwork window are null rather than transcribed from an unverifiable reading.

2016 special pre-election poll conducted online 27–30 June 2016, n=1,212 (Your Source); printed to the nearest 0.5 point (components sum to 100.5); NXT printed as its own SA-only column, kept as 'nxt' beside the five standard keys (oth excludes NXT as printed). Publication 1 July 2016.

2019 weekly omnibus 10–14 May 2019, n=1,201 (Qualtrics), published 14 May; components printed Liberal 36.2 / National 3.6 with the report's own combined line reading 38.5 (rounding); 2PP 51.5 Labor (2016 flows); Publication 14 May 2019.
2022 not probed: Essential suspended its voting-intention question after the 2019 election and resumed only in late 2023 — there is no 2022 final-week Essential VI cross-tab to file.
